title: Parity-weighted Boolean function
statement: For a Boolean function $g$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a set of coordinates $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define the function whose value at each input $x$ is the parity function on $S$ evaluated at $x$, multiplied by $g(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $g$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
